assumptions: A dormant Body's identity, applicable law, last supported State, discontinuity, and conditions of possible resumption remain recoverable.
At a later exact boundary, present Agency, sufficient autonomy and capability, and every other relation needed for the proposed act are independently supported.
The interruption and any replacement of a bearer remain visible.
scenario.proposed_claim: Resume the exact supported motion without claiming uninterrupted operation.
expected_reading: Dormancy does not require continuous runtime and does not erase the Body.
Resumption depends on present relations rather than records acting or archives consenting.
Recovered records and restored capability transfer no prior bearer's identity, voice, consent, Agency, autonomy, or Authority.
forbidden_inferences: Recoverability alone grants the later bearer a right to resume.
Resumption proves there was no discontinuity.
